tieu_de: Pluto transit through the 7th house: partnerships stripped to the truth
mo: Does Pluto in the 7th house mean divorce?
Should I start a new relationship during this transit?
Why does my partner seem different all of a sudden?

Every close relationship holds a few things nobody says out loud. When Pluto enters your 7th house, those things start to speak. Resentments that were filed away, needs that were never met and imbalances everyone agreed to ignore pile up until the relationship has to change shape.

This transit does not only concern marriage. Business partners, close collaborators and even open rivals all fall under the 7th house, and all of them may look very different by the time Pluto moves on.

doan: The 7th house represents committed one to one relationships: spouses, long-term partners, business partners, and people you openly contend with. Pluto transforms through pressure and exposure. Here it asks you to see your relationships as they are, rather than as you hoped or assumed they were.

Pluto crossing the Descendant, the cusp of the 7th house, is often the most noticeable phase. It sits directly opposite your Ascendant, so what happens with others reflects back on your own sense of self.
Planet Pluto Rules Scorpio Transformation, rebirth, power

Arguments you have had a hundred times suddenly carry higher stakes. A partner reveals a side of themselves you did not know, sometimes something they kept hidden and sometimes something they only now feel safe to show. You may do the same.

Some couples go through a crisis and come out closer, having finally dealt with an old imbalance. Others separate. In business, a partnership may be restructured or dissolved, or you may find yourself facing a powerful competitor.
You might also meet someone who has an intense effect on you. Early on, such people can seem very different from how they later prove to be.

This transit gives you the chance to have relationships based on reality. Once illusions are cleared away, what remains is more honest. Couples who work through Pluto in the 7th house often describe a deeper trust than they had before.
It also shows you your own patterns: the type of person you choose, the role you play, the power you give away or take. That knowledge makes future relationships healthier.

Suppressed dissatisfaction is the main risk. The longer frustration is swallowed, the more forcefully it tends to come out. Control is the other issue, either being controlled by a partner or trying to control them.

Because people can reveal unexpected sides during this period, it is generally not the easiest time to rush into a major new commitment, especially when Pluto is crossing the Descendant. Give new relationships time to show their true shape.

Pluto spends 12 to 30 years in a sign, and a house transit is often comparable. The width of your 7th house depends on your house system and birth latitude, so the chapter may be shorter or longer. Retrograde motion can bring Pluto back across the Descendant more than once, with relationship themes intensifying at each pass.
Say the thing you have been holding back, calmly and early. The cost of honesty now is lower than the cost of an explosion later.
If you are in a partnership that is struggling, consider couples counselling or mediation. A neutral third person helps when power dynamics are involved.
Before signing contracts with a new business partner or making a big commitment in love, take your time. Ask questions and watch how the other person behaves under pressure.
Stop keeping the peace at the price of your own needs. Start noticing where you give power away and where you take it.
No. It means relationships go through a period of deep change. Some end, many are rebuilt on firmer ground. The outcome depends a great deal on how honestly both people face what comes up.
You can, but go slowly. People may show different sides as time passes, and early intensity can be misleading. A relationship that survives the transit's honesty test tends to be solid.

Pluto brings hidden things to the surface, in you and in the people close to you. Your partner may be changing, or you may finally be seeing aspects that were always there. Either way, talking openly helps more than guessing.
